s: Hi everyone, and welcome to Word Kitchen.
Health is important for all of us.
Our five words are nurse, hospital, medicine, pill, and fever.
When I was a child, I was sick.
A kind nurse gave me water.
She works every day and helps many sick people.
So, remember: a nurse helps sick people.
A hospital is a big building.
Sick people go to the hospital.
The nurse works at the hospital.
When people are very sick, they go to the hospital.
I went to the hospital last year.
The hospital was big and clean.
A nurse welcomed me at the door.
Many nurses and doctors work at the hospital.
They help people feel better at the hospital.
Medicine helps you when you are sick.
You take medicine to feel better.
When you have a fever, the nurse gives you medicine.
Medicine helps your body get well.
My doctor gave me medicine last week.
I took the medicine with water.
So medicine is what you take when you are sick.
A pill is a small round medicine.
You take the pill with water.
A pill is one kind of medicine.
You eat the pill with water.
The nurse gave me a small white pill.
She said, take the pill after breakfast.
I took the pill with a glass of water.
A pill is small medicine you take with water.
When you have a fever, your body is very hot.
A fever means you are sick.
If you have a fever, you stay in bed.
The nurse can help you when you have a fever.
Last month I had a fever.
I took medicine for the fever and I drank a lot of water.
And when you have a fever, it is good to go to the hospital.
The nurse at the hospital can check your fever.
Let's use all five words in one little story.
At the hospital, a kind nurse helps him.
The medicine is one small pill.
The man takes the pill with water.
Let's do it again with you, our listeners.
She goes to the hospital with her daughter.
At the hospital, a nurse smiles at them.
The nurse gives the woman medicine.
The medicine is a small white pill.
The woman takes the pill with water.
Then the nurse says, rest at home.
Now you know our five words: nurse, hospital, medicine, pill, and fever.
Thank you for listening to Word Kitchen.
